# libusb

The parts of libusb the core builds (`libusb/` with its headers, and of `libusb/os/` the Linux
and Windows backends the Makefile lists, with their headers), its licence and its authors,
copied unchanged from https://github.com/shadexternals/libusb (branch shadps4) at commit
d087ea86539ab1f1ec42faf86e2357e2fad126a6. The build's config.h is libretro/libusb-config. To
move it on, copy the same files from a newer commit over these.
